about_short_description.short_description: Disclosures.io builds software to help real estate agents manage property disclosures such as leaking roofs and broken sewer lines.

product.name: HomeLight Listing Management (HLM)
product.description: A cloud-based platform for real estate professionals to manage property listings from pre-market to offer acceptance, including document management, offer tracking, and closing services.

product.name: Seller Disclosures & Form Filling
product.description: A digital tool within HLM that facilitates the completion and management of seller disclosure forms to reduce errors and agent liability.

product.name: Listing Information Packages
product.description: Digital packages of supplemental property documents that can be shared privately or publicly and include tracking of buyer engagement.

product.name: Offer Management Dashboard
product.description: An online dashboard within HLM that organizes, compares, and manages all offers received on a property listing.

product.name: Closing Services
product.description: A secure, centralized platform within HLM for managing and accessing all closing documents and communications during escrow.

product.name: Document Management and PDF Tools
product.description: Tools within HLM to manage, edit, and organize listing documents, including splitting, reordering, and redacting PDFs without external software.
